about_the_game:
DESCRIPTION

I took a simple night job.

A gym. 10 PM to 6 AM.

Not many customers, easy work.

Spot their lifts.

Make their protein shakes.

Fix things when they break.

Just another routine job.

...Or so I thought.

SOMETHING'S OFF 

"Huh? That guy didn't show up again today."

"Did you see the news about the missing people?"

"The manager... doesn't he seem a bit off to you?"

Regulars vanishing without a trace.

Questions piling up.

And a basement door that never opens.

FEATURES

● Four Nights of Work

- Watch the ordinary slowly turn unsettling

● Gym Job Simulation

- Set up weights for each customer's workout

- Spot exercises, mix protein shakes, handle the night shift

● Dread Through Dialogue

- No monsters. But humans can be far worse.

- Piece together the unease through conversations

● When Normal Stops Feeling Safe

- By the time familiar spaces start feeling wrong,

- You're already in too deep.

WARNING 

This game contains jump scares and psychological horror elements.

short_description: A normal night shift at a gym. But the regulars are disappearing one by one. Why does the manager keep the basement locked? Four nights. The horror hidden in plain sight.
